mapping_rule: Keep queue stable IDs and official SES numbers. PDF lecture ordinal differs from SES number after the first four: resolve by the actual index row, never by filename guess.
methodology: Downloaded official index and every linked resource page; resolved one actual PDF per queued session. Stored exact URL, hash, page count and per-page extracted-text metrics. Rendered all270 file pages at1.7x and actually viewed all contact sheets, then detailed images for dense equations, figure labels, source numbering gaps and the lone raster-only page. Source errors do not themselves cause exclusion. Fully readable means complete published assigned lecture content can be faithfully read; tiny nonconsequential illustrative screenshot glyphs are caveated, not converted into a content blocker.
